in_marathi.name: Nilkamal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nilkamal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nilkamal is a Sanskrit name derived from the blue lotus flower. In Hindu mythology, the lotus flower symbolizes purity, enlightenment, and detachment. It is believed that Lord Vishnu resides in the lotus that grows in the heart of every being. Thus, Nilkamal is a beautiful name for a baby boy, representing the spiritual journey towards enlightenment.
